description: This file defines the CustomLoader class within the Api\Core\Loader namespace. It provides static methods for managing custom paths, merging arrays, including custom configuration files, and loading custom routes. It appears to be part of a larger web application framework, likely related to SuiteCRM or SugarCRM, facilitating customizable routing and configuration via external PHP files.

classes.name: CustomLoader
classes.description: Provides static methods to handle custom configuration and route files, error management, and array merging for extension points in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework.

methods.name: setCustomPath
methods.description: Sets the directory path where custom files are located.

methods.name: getCustomPath
methods.description: Retrieves the currently set custom directory path.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error code and resets it to no error.

methods.name: arrayMerge
methods.description: Recursively merges multiple multidimensional arrays, handling integer and associative keys appropriately.

methods.name: mergeCustomArray
methods.description: Includes a custom PHP file which should return an array, merges it with the provided array, and sets error codes if file is missing or incorrectly formatted.

methods.name: loadCustomRoutes
methods.description: Includes a PHP routes configuration file into the app if it exists.
